test_full_model: test the TransformerDo model with random integer inputs and verify output shape and finiteness
test_causality: test the TransformerDo model maintains causal prediction by checking positional encoding gradients
test_heads_divides_dimension: test that TransformerDo raises an error when head count does not divide the dimension
